open_findings: P32E runtime refresh: NOT DONE. Nothing constructs a directory frame source for an installed pack, and nothing rebuilds the catalog, visual registry, availability cache or avatar on install. The audit named the avatar as the hard one: it caches the registry and director at init (companion_avatar.dart:161-162,189-197) and its build deliberately does not watch them (:409-415,433-459).
P32: no integration test yet proves an installed pack becomes selectable and renders WITHOUT a restart. The audit said the existing tests cannot show that; it needs a new one.

P34: cat and rabbit have NO geometry contract (assets/companions/<c>/animation_manifest.json is dog-only), so manifest.py now refuses them. Their packs cannot be certified until a contract is written for each. This is a real gap in the shipped asset tooling, not a code bug.

tools/productionise.py measure() reads split()[-1] as alpha; on the indexed PNGs the packs ship, that band is the palette index. audit_pack_geometry.py converts to RGBA first. productionise itself was not changed - worth a look before P34, since it writes the production report the manifest is built from.

P32: symlink rejection is NOT verified through the reader. ZipEncoder drops symbolicLink through a round trip, so isSymbolicLink comes back false. The policy refusal is covered directly; whether the decoder reports a real symlink is unverified.
P32: duplicate-name ZIP entries cannot be built with ZipEncoder; the policy rule is covered directly but not through the reader.
P32: the reader does not fabricate a compressed size, so the expansion-ratio bomb check is inert on this path; per-entry and total byte caps still apply.
docs/companion_assets.md is stale: claims 1024x1024 canvas with 919/511 anchors and that every pack must be added to pubspec.yaml; the real JSON is 512x512 with ~458/255.
P33: multi_companion_parity_test forces every profile to the dog's 13 actions. Right for built-ins, wrong as an admission requirement for a user partial pack; the two contracts must be scoped apart.
P28.4: room_sit still projects to idle with no frames of its own; sofa/sit and rug/sit are hidden from the panel, but the routine and idle still select room_sit.

Room: the travel ticker starts immediately after startTravel and _onCompanionAnimationChanged is empty, so the comment claiming movement waits for stand_up describes behaviour the code does not implement.
